# mailcraft

> Agent-native, self-hosted email: transactional sends, event-triggered lifecycle automations, and LLM-written emails behind a validator and approval queue. AGPL-3.0. Pre-alpha.

Use test keys (`mc_test_...`) until a human approves go-live. Never print or ask for API keys. Always pass `--json`. Mutating calls accept `idempotency_key` and `dry_run`.

## Start here
- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md): docker compose up -d, mailcraft init, mailcraft domain add; no-domain Gmail path
- [Agent setup](agent-setup.md): MCP URL and config, init flow, what needs a human
- [AGENTS.md snippet](AGENTS.md): what `mailcraft init` appends to a project
- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json): single source of truth for REST, CLI and MCP
- [MCP server](/mcp): Streamable HTTP; OAuth or `Authorization: Bearer mc_...`

## Skills
- [mailcraft](SKILL.md): overview, rules, setup flow
- [mailcraft-send-email](skills/mailcraft-send-email/SKILL.md): send, dry-run, test addresses, idempotency
- [mailcraft-setup-domain](skills/mailcraft-setup-domain/SKILL.md): add a domain, DNS, verify, doctor, no-domain Gmail
- [mailcraft-build-automation](skills/mailcraft-build-automation/SKILL.md): events, JSON automation pack, approvals
- [mailcraft-write-templates](skills/mailcraft-write-templates/SKILL.md): JSON block format, variables, import/export

## Reference
- [CLI](cli.md): commands, flags, exit codes (0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage, 3 auth, 4 policy/approval, 5 retryable, 6 not found, 7 checks failed)
- [Errors](errors/index.md): every core code with a fix; each error has `hint` and `doc_url`
